consensus_summary: Overall, fans agree that the December 15, 1972 show at Long Beach Arena features solid performances, particularly in the second set. While it may not be the most remarkable show of the year, standout moments like the Truckin' > Dark Star > Morning Dew sequence are frequently praised.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 25 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the show and highlighted specific jams, several reviews noted that it doesn't reach the heights of other 1972 performances, leading to a mixed overall sentiment.
